style: GTA-inspired Western street racing; revised after user feedback

sprint.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a 16:9 premium street-racing videogame menu background, 2048 x 1152, for the mountain sprint track 彎道衝刺. Visual direction: the bold illustrated loading-screen art and Western street-racing attitude of GTA, with graphic dark contours, painterly yet crisp hard-surface detail, high-contrast teal shadows and hot amber highlights. This must feel like a dangerous FAST racing circuit, not a scenic travel landscape. Very low wide-angle trackside camera, strong diagonal perspective: dark asphalt rushes from the lower edge into a dramatic tight S-bend cut into a forested mountain, scarred metal guardrails, red-and-white racing kerbs, large yellow-black turn chevrons, tire skid arcs, unbranded race barriers and an overhead track gantry in the middle distance. Directional motion streaks in the road edges and passing foliage, subtle warm headlight/red taillight trails threading through the distant bend, thin tire haze, a dramatic dusky sky and jagged mountain silhouettes. The actual track and racing infrastructure are the stars. High energy, aggressive, stylish, slightly gritty, AAA open-world racing key art. Do not include any foreground car because an interactive 3D car will be overlaid in the center lower half of the menu. Allow a relatively quiet upper-center sky for interface title text, but the surrounding scene must stay dynamic. No parking lot, no scenic overlook, no large empty plaza. No people, no text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no border. Fully original artwork inspired by that visual language, not a recreation of an existing game poster.

drift.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a 16:9 premium street-racing videogame menu background, 2048 x 1152, for tropical coastal circuit 熱浪夏威夷. Visual direction: GTA's bold illustrated loading-screen art and stylish Western coastal street-racing attitude, graphic dark contours, painterly but crisp surfaces, saturated coral-orange sunset versus turquoise and deep violet shadows. This must look like a FAST street-racing track, not a holiday postcard. Low wide-angle camera almost on the tarmac, dramatic diagonal perspective, a wide coastal racing road rushing from the lower edge into a sweeping banked curve, bright red-and-white racing kerbs, concrete racing barriers and yellow-black chevrons. Tall palms whip past along the edges with directional motion blur; aqua ocean on one side and a compressed pastel beach-city skyline and elevated highway on the other, hard sunlight and long shadows, subtle magenta neon accents on distant buildings. Show skid marks, glowing light trails sweeping around the curve, and a little tire haze for speed. High contrast, energetic, confident, gritty polished AAA racing game key art. The road and racing infrastructure dominate the composition. No foreground cars because a separate interactive 3D car will be overlaid at center lower half. Keep upper-center sky relatively quiet for interface titles, but keep the sides and track fast and visually exciting. No parking lot, no scenic lookout, no empty plaza. No people, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no border. Fully original artwork inspired by this visual language, not a recreation of an existing GTA poster.
